entities.summary: The cakewalk was a dance developed from the "prize walks" held in the mid-19th century, generally at get-togethers of Black people on plantations before and after emancipation in the Southern United States. Alternative names for the original form of the dance were "chalkline-walk", and the "walk-around". It was originally a processional partner dance performed with comical formality.
